intro: The **Product Details initializer** configures how product information is displayed and managed, including images, descriptions, pricing, and options. Use initialization to customize product data models and enhance product presentation.

scope.description: Defines the store view scope for product data retrieval. Used in multi-store setups to fetch store-specific product information.

defaultLocale.description: Sets the default locale for product content when no specific locale is detected.

globalLocale.description: Overrides locale detection and forces all product content to use this specific locale regardless of user settings.

sku.description: Pre-loads a specific product SKU on initialization. Useful for server-side rendering or direct product page access.

acdl.description: Configuration for Adobe Client Data Layer (ACDL) integration to track product view events and user interactions for analytics.

anchors.description: Controls hash navigation behavior for product page sections (e.g., #reviews, #specifications). Enables deep linking to specific content areas.

persistURLParams.description: Determines which URL query parameters should persist when navigating between product variants. Useful for tracking campaigns or referral sources.

preselectFirstOption.description: When `true`, automatically selects the first available option for each configurable attribute. Streamlines selection for products with default variants.

optionsUIDs.description: Pre-selects specific product options by their unique identifiers. Useful for direct links to configured product variants (e.g., specific size/color combinations).
